title: Define a transport-neutral public semantic API
context: Cold inheritors need a discoverable interrogation surface without learning a particular binding or transport.
decision: Public API v0.1 defines semantic operations and capability discovery above bindings. Specification and conformance remain authoritative; JavaScript, TypeScript, and CLI are adapters or proof implementations. CLI JSON is the lowest-common-denominator path. Missing evidence remains unknown. HTTP and MCP are intentionally not canonical transports.
alternativesConsidered: Make a JavaScript class layout canonical
Choose HTTP or MCP as the canonical API
rationale: Stable, discoverable semantics support cold inheritance while transports and implementations remain replaceable.
assumptions: Plain UTF-8 JSON remains sufficient for cross-language exchange
revisitConditions: A backward-incompatible Public API revision is proposed
